EditorMetadata.Description: P1b (Hill-attack -> Blueprints migration), tree-INTEGRATION track (architect Q#9-A): the integrated twin of HillAssault2_DispatchWaveWithTargets.bp.json -- SAME logic/kernels as the isolated twin, but leaves its native WorkingState EMPTY and converses over the standalone entity-scoped HillAttackSharedState struct via GetShared/SetShared(VariableId="state"). Mechanically generated by scripts/hill_attack_integration transform (see PR description): every twin GetVariable(F) node was replaced 1:1 with a [GetShared("state") -> HillAttackSharedStateOps.Get<F>(s)] pair (same fan-out topology preserved); every twin SetVariable(F) node was replaced 1:1 with a [GetShared("state") -> HillAttackSharedStateOps.With<F>(s, v) -> SetShared("state")] triple (fresh full-struct read immediately before each write, so sibling fields are never clobbered; correct inside FlowForEach bodies too, since GetShared/SetShared are ordinary ordered per-occurrence backing-storage accesses and FlowForEach lowers to a real inline-body loop -- confirmed via Hrot.Blueprints.Compiler Stage5 StatementEmitter.cs IrOp_ReadVariable/IrOp_WriteVariable and the GetShared/SetShared TryGetShared/TrySetShared emission). All other nodes (FlowForEach, Branch, Compare, FunctionCall kernels, PublishEvent, Literal, GetParameter) are byte-for-byte identical to the isolated twin. Does not modify the C# oracle, the isolated twin (HillAssault2_DispatchWaveWithTargets.bp.json), any *Ops/*Json/struct .cs file, or the compiler.
